title: HandoffToProcessSummary
description: Asynchronous invocation payload sent by summary-posted to process-summary. The huddle path carries IDs only (process-summary resolves the thread with files.info); the manual path carries the summary text and what process-summary needs to find summary-posted's in-channel ack with conversations.history.

huddle_handoff.description: A Slack-generated huddle summary file was shared.

job_id.description: The Slack file ID (equal to file_id).

file_id.description: A Slack ID such as a channel, user or file ID.

channel_id.description: A Slack ID such as a channel, user or file ID.

user_id.description: The user who shared the file (USLACKBOT for huddle summaries).

manual_handoff.description: A user ran /meetingsummary with the summary text. There is no thread_ts: process-summary finds the ack later and may fall back to channel level.

job_id.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of channel_id + ':' + trigger_id (architecture §6).

channel_id.description: A Slack ID such as a channel, user or file ID.

user_id.description: The user who ran the command.

command_ts.description: When the command was sent (the X-Slack-Request-Timestamp header); process-summary searches channel history from here.

summary_text.description: The meeting summary entered by the user. Never stored or logged.

job_reference.description: Short reference derived from job_id that summary-posted puts in its in-channel ack, so process-summary can find the ack.
